entries.look: Never leaves the car running. Says it is a tell.
entries.bio: Drove ambulances for eleven years before somebody offered better money.

entries.look: Knows the name of everyone on the door.
entries.bio: Has never personally stolen anything and has arranged a great deal of theft.

actors.name: The night manager

entries.look: Forty, tired, and counting the minutes until six.
entries.read: Craft Target 11: he has been skimming, and he is more frightened of the audit than of you.

narration: He puts both hands flat on the desk, very slowly, without being asked.

stats.summary: Ordinary person, out of his depth
meta: keys, a pager, a ledger he should have burned

sections.label: Actions
rows: One round to reach it. He will not, if anyone is kind to him.

sections.label: Running him
rows: He wants to be talked into it. Let the Fixer find that in one question.

items.name: The night manager's ledger
items.text: Green cloth cover, two years of entries.
items.detail: Every skimmed figure, in his own hand.
items.secret: Worth more than the vault. Give it to one player and nobody else.

scenes.name: The city, after midnight
scenes.description: Wet streets, one bank, and four hours until the shift changes.

entries.label: Opening
entries.text: The rain stopped an hour ago and nobody has noticed yet. The Kestrel Building has one light on, on the third floor, and it has been on all week.

options: Send the Fixer to the door

checks.success: One unmarked car, occupied, two blocks down. It has been there both nights.

cues.text: Say the number out loud. Always.

prep.wrong: The third-floor light never goes off.

scenes.name: The Kestrel Building, lobby
scenes.description: Marble, one desk, and a man behind it who is not supposed to be alone.

entries.label: Through the doors
entries.text: He looks up before the door has finished opening, which means he was already listening for it.

checks.success: He has been skimming. He is more frightened of the audit than of you.
checks.failure: A tired man doing a job.

cues.when: If anyone is kind to him

prep.wrong: He is alone, and he should not be.

stages.dmText: The unmarked car is the real clock.
The night manager is the whole scene. He wants to be talked into it.

clocks.name: Until the shift changes
clocks.caption: Four hours, and it does not stop for conversation.

events.playerText: A patrol car turns onto the street.
Headlights, and the day staff arriving.
events.dmText: Out of time. Whatever is unfinished stays unfinished.
